label: Athom Homey Pro (2023) smart-home hub
description: Athom Homey Pro (early 2023) is a local-first home-automation controller with Zigbee 3.0, Z-Wave 700, Thread, Matter, Bluetooth LE 5.0, 433 MHz and an IR blaster, serving its own web app on the LAN. Networking is Wi-Fi only as shipped - dual-band 2.4/5 GHz 802.11 b/g/n/ac - because the box has no RJ45 jack; Ethernet is possible only through the separately sold Homey Pro Ethernet Adapter that plugs into its USB-C port.
